summary: This Form 6-K filed by Biophytis SA (foreign private issuer) announces the official registration of its joint venture in Hong Kong, Biophytis Biopharmaceutical Group Limited, a milestone under a strategic partnership disclosed earlier. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other special situation M&A event occurs in this filing. The filing is a routine press release attached as exhibit; no price, premium, board recommendation, or advisor is mentioned. The joint venture will receive up to $20 million in staged funding, with an initial $3 million tranche upon operational closing in July 2026. As a non-US filing, this equates to a routine current report on Form 6-K. No special-situation deal terms or risk-arb angle apply.
